intro: Dominica is a parliamentary republic, independent since 1978.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is head of state, elected by parliament; the prime minister, Roosevelt Skerrit since 2004, leads the government.

chapters.title: Eugenia Charles
text: Eugenia Charles became the Caribbean's first woman prime minister in 1980.

keyTerms.meaning: A country with an elected head of state.
